decisions.statement: A settings document declares the settings a harness is told rather than deriving that.
The hook registrations are derived from the agent hook pages instead.
A derived document is merged over this document and written outside the repository.
A running seat watches the derived document rather than this page.
A page here says the settings one program reads rather than the settings every program reads.
One path writes a seat's client configuration.
Which command launched a seat does not change the path writing that configuration.

definition: one document declaring how the agent harness on this workstation is set up
